import hashlib,json,sys,types
from pathlib import Path
from pilot import search as current
from pilot.tasks import Task
root=Path.cwd(); scratch=Path(sys.argv[1])/"fixed-calibration"
snapshot=json.loads((root/"evidence/pilot/source-snapshot-7.json").read_text())
old=types.ModuleType("pilot_before_refusal"); old.__file__=str(root/"pilot/search.py")
exec(compile(snapshot["files"]["pilot/search.py"],old.__file__,"exec"),old.__dict__)
task=Task("synthetic",[{"id":f"t{i}","input":"train"} for i in range(40)],[{"id":f"s{i}","input":"selection"} for i in range(3)],{}, {"prompt":"seed"})
noise=json.loads((root/"evidence/pilot/mbpp-readmission-4a/mbpp/controls.json").read_text())
rows=[]
for method in ("hone","gepa","plain"):
    captured=[]; results=[]
    for label,module in (("before",old),("after",current)):
        calls=[]
        def call(role,messages,max_tokens):
            calls.append([role,messages,max_tokens])
            return "better" if method=="gepa" else '{"prompt":"better"}'
        def evaluate(candidate,batch,capture_traces=False):
            result={"scores":[0.0]*len(batch),"outputs":[""]*len(batch),"trajectories":[{"id":row["id"],"input":row["input"],"output":"","score":0.0,"feedback":"synthetic failure","calls":[]} for row in batch] if capture_traces else []}
            if label=="after": result.update(refusals=[],refusals_by_row={})
            return result
        results.append(module.run_search(method,task,call,evaluate,lambda:True,noise,0,scratch/(method+"-"+label),1))
        captured.append(calls)
    assert captured[0]==captured[1],method
    assert results[0]["candidate"]==results[1]["candidate"] and results[0]["selection_score"]==results[1]["selection_score"],method
    rows.append({"method":method,"calls_before":len(captured[0]),"calls_after":len(captured[1]),"identical_role_messages_and_max_tokens":True,"request_sequence_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(captured[1],sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest(),"same_retained_artifact_and_score":True})
print(json.dumps({"probes":rows,"model_requests":0,"actual_native_gepa_and_hone_policy_exercised":True},sort_keys=True))
